challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: I am prepared to accept the loss of automated hyperparameter tuning for the time being. If the weekly retraining cycle can be compressed significantly, I will stop pushing for that specific automation. The immediate priority is validating the new weather features before the next promotion week. I value the speed of iteration over the convenience of fully automated tuning right now. This trade allows us to focus engineering effort on the evaluation harness rather than the training pipeline itself.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are prepared to accept the loss of automated hyperparameter tuning in exchange for a faster retraining cycle and focus on validation, which fits the definition of giving up something to accept another outcome.
